daft punk.x: Daft Punk were a French electronic music duo formed in 1993 in Paris by Thomas Bangalter and Guy-Manuel de Homem-Christo. They achieved popularity in the late 1990s as part of the French house movement, combining elements of house, funk, disco, techno and rock.

david guetta.x: Pierre David Guetta is a French DJ and record producer. He has sold over 10 million albums and 65 million singles globally, with more than 40 billion streams on Spotify. Guetta was voted the number one DJ in the DJ Mag Top 100 DJs polls in 2011, 2020, 2021, 2023, 2025, and 2026.

david holmes.x: David Holmes is a Northern Irish musician and composer. He worked as a DJ before releasing several solo albums that incorporated elements of trip hop, big beat, rock and electronic music.

daya.x: Grace Martine Tandon, known professionally as Daya, is an American singer and songwriter from the Pittsburgh suburb of Mt. Lebanon, Pennsylvania. She released her self-titled debut extended play, Daya, on September 4, 2015.

dandy livingstone.x: Dandy Livingstone is a British-Jamaican ska, rocksteady and reggae musician and record producer, best known for his 1972 hit "Suzanne Beware of the Devil", and for his song "Rudy, a Message to You", which was later a hit for the Specials. "Suzanne Beware of the Devil" reached…

de mthuda.x: Mthuthuzeli Gift Khoza, known commonly by his stage name De Mthuda, is a South African record producer and DJ. He is best known for his singles "Shesha Geza" and "John Wick ".

deadmau5.x: Joel Thomas Zimmerman, known professionally as Deadmau5, is a Canadian electronic music producer and DJ.

delilah.x: Paloma Ayana Stoecker, who records under the name Delilah, is an English singer-songwriter. Born in Paris, France, Delilah moved to Camden, London, England, at an early age where she later attended City and Islington College.

delroy washington.x: Delroy Washington was a Jamaican-British reggae singer best known for his releases for Virgin Records in the late 1970s.

delroy wilson.x: Delroy George Wilson CD was a Jamaican ska, rocksteady and reggae singer. Wilson is often regarded as Jamaica's first child star, having first found success as a teenager. His youngest son, Karl "Konan" Wilson, has found success as part of British duo Krept and Konan.

denise belfon.x: Denise "Saucy Wow" Belfon is a soca and R&B singer, songwriter and dancer.

dennis ferrer.x: Dennis Ferrer is a New York–based DJ, producer and remixer. He currently resides in Union City, New Jersey.

deuce.x: Aron Erlichman, better known by his stage name Deuce, is an American rapper, music producer and guitarist.

dido.x: Dido Florian Cloud de Bounevialle O'Malley Armstrong, known mononymously as Dido, is an English singer and songwriter. She attained international success with her debut album No Angel; hit singles from the album include "Here with Me" and "Thank You".

diplo.x: Thomas Wesley "Wes" Pentz Jr., known professionally as Diplo, is an American DJ and record producer. He gained recognition in 2008 with his single "Blow Your Head".

dj chus.x: DJ Chus is a Spanish electronic music producer, remixer and DJ. He works mainly in house music.

dj clock.x: Kholile Elvin Gumede, better known as DJ Clock, is a South African DJ and record producer.

dj enuff.x: Ephrem Louis Lopez Sr., known professionally as DJ Enuff, is an American DJ and radio personality. Born in Harlem and raised in Brooklyn, he joined New York City's hip-hop radio station Hot 97 in 1998, where he has since hosted DJ mixes.

dj fresh.x: Daniel Edward Stein, known professionally as DJ Fresh, is an English DJ and record producer. He is one of the principal members of the drum and bass group Bad Company, alongside Darren White, Jason Maldini and Michael Wojcicki.

dj qness.x: Qhubani Ndlovu, also known as DJ Qness, is a South African DJ. He is a Music executive, Songwriter and Television producer.

dj stokie.x: Setoki Mbatha, professionally known as DJ Stokie, is a South African DJ. Born and raised in Mzimhlophe, Soweto, he developed a musical interest at a young age and contested on Mad Half Hour by YFM in 2006.

dlala thukzin.x: Thuthuka Wandile Zindlovu, prominently known as Dlala Thukzin is a South African DJ and record producer born and bred in Lamontville, KwaZulu-Natal. He is famous for his versatility of blending amapiano and afro tech with gqom.

dogheart.x: Dogheart is a garage/indie rock band, formed in Portland, Oregon in 2014 by Matt Jenkins, Gray Hildreth, and Cameron Hering. Members of the group formed together after having played in different projects in the music scene in Portland.

dom dolla.x: Dominic Louis Matheson, better known by his stage name Dom Dolla, is an Australian tech house producer, DJ, songwriter and remixer, acclaimed for his special house music style and high-profile collaborations.

doudou masta.x: Mamadou Doumbia is a French hip-hop artist and actor.

dr alban.x: Ogbuagu Alban Uzoma Nwapa, better known by his stage name Dr. Alban, is a Nigerian-Swedish musician and producer with his own record label, Dr. Records.

dr alimantado.x: Dr Alimantado, also known as The Ital Surgeon, is a Jamaican reggae singer, deejay, and producer.

dres.x: Andres "Dres" Vargas-Titus is an American hip hop artist. He is known for being the lead rapper of the alternative hip hop duo Black Sheep, before recording as a solo artist.

drink to get drunk.x: "Drink to Get Drunk" is a song by Australian singer-songwriter Sia. It was included on her second studio album Healing Is Difficult. The song was released as a single in 2001 after it was remixed by Gino Scaletti and Quinn Whalley.

dusky.x: Dusky is an English electronic music duo from London consisting of Alfie Granger-Howell and Nick Harriman. Formed in 2011, they have released music on various records labels, before setting up their own label 17 Steps in July 2014 with the release of the Love Taking Over EP.

babalwa m.x: Babalwa Mavuso, professionally known as Babalwa M, is a South African singer-songwriter. Born in Orlando, Soweto and grew up in Protea Glen, Babalwa first gained recognition after releasing her extended play Bayeke in 2020.

balearic beat.x: Balearic beat, also known as Balearic house, Balearic, Ibiza house or Ibizan chillout, is an eclectic blend of DJ-led dance music that emerged in the mid-1980s. It later became the name of a more specific style of electronic dance/house music that was popular into the mid-1990s.

barrington levy.x: Barrington Ainsworth Levy is a Jamaican reggae and dancehall musician from Clarendon, Jamaica.

barry can t swim.x: Joshua Spence Mainnie, known professionally as Barry Can't Swim, is a Scottish electronic music producer and DJ from Edinburgh.

ben bohmer.x: Ben Böhmer is a German DJ, producer and remixer from Göttingen, Germany. He primarily produces and performs indie electronica and melodic house music, and has released tracks on labels Ninja Tune, Anjunadeep, Keller Records, and Cercle Music. He lives in Berlin.

beneficence.x: Rahim Muhammad, known by the stage name Beneficence, is an American rapper from Newark, New Jersey.

benny benassi.x: Marco "Benny" Benassi is an Italian DJ and music producer. He is widely seen as a pioneer of electro house, a genre brought into the mainstream by his 2002 summer club hit "Satisfaction".

bicep.x: Bicep are an electronic music production and DJ duo from Belfast, Northern Ireland, consisting of Andrew Ferguson and Matthew McBriar.

bj rn torske.x: Bjørn Torske is a house music producer. He became involved with producing music and local radio before moving to Bergen, Norway. He has collaborated on many occasions with Röyksopp.

bob sinclar.x: Christophe Le Friant, better known by his stage name Bob Sinclar, is a French record producer, DJ, and remixer. He is the owner of the record label Yellow Productions.

bonga.x: José Adelino Barceló de Carvalho, better known as Bonga, is an Angolan folk and semba singer-songwriter.

bongeziwe mabandla.x: Bongeziwe Mabandla is a South African musician based in Johannesburg, predominantly playing folk music with lyrics in isiXhosa, accompanied by a guitar.

bonobo.x: Simon Charles Green, known by his stage name Bonobo, is an English musician, producer, and DJ based in Los Angeles. He debuted with a trip hop aesthetic and has since explored more upbeat approaches as well as jazz and world music influences.

boo seeka.x: Boo Seeka is the solo project of Australian electropop singer-songwriter, Ben "Boo" Gumbleton. Boo Seeka have released three studio albums.

boohle.x: Buhlebevangeli Hlengiwe Manyathi, professionally known as Boohle, is a South African singer and songwriter. She is popularly known for her songs "Yini Na", "Mama", "Siyathandana" and "Hamba wena". Her music is a combination of amapiano, afro-house, afro-soul, and gospel.

boris brejcha.x: Boris Brejcha is a German DJ and record producer. He describes his music style as "high-tech minimal." Brejcha frequently wears a joker mask based on a Carnival of Venice design. He has performed at clubs and festivals around the world, including Tomorrowland and Coachella.

brainpower.x: Gertjan Mulder, better known as Brainpower, is a Dutch rapper. Born in Belgium, he grew up in the Netherlands.

brass tacks.x: Brass Tacks is an album by the rock band NRBQ. It was released by Clang! Records on June 17, 2014.

brenden praise.x: Brenden Praise Ledwaba known by the stage name of Brenden Praise, is a South African singer-songwriter and music producer. Ledwaba rose to prominence after contested on Idols South Africa season 9 and became a runner-up.

bryan ferry.x: Bryan Ferry is an English singer and musician. He became known as the frontman of the band Roxy Music and also launched a solo career. Born to a working-class family, Ferry studied fine art and taught at a secondary school before pursuing a career in music.

bucie.x: Busisiwe Nolubabalo Nqwiliso is a South African R&B and house singer.

burning spear.x: Winston Rodney OD, better known by the stage name Burning Spear, is a Jamaican roots reggae singer-songwriter, vocalist, and musician. Burning Spear is a Rastafarian and one of the most influential and long-standing roots artists to emerge from the 1970s.

busi mhlongo.x: Busi Mhlongo, born Victoria Busisiwe Mhlongo, was a singer, dancer and composer originally from Inanda in Natal, South Africa.

busiswa.x: Busiswa Gqulu, known mononymously as Busiswa, is a South African singer-songwriter and poet. Born in Mthatha, Eastern Cape, South Africa, she gained public recognition for her feature on DJ Zinhle's song, "My Name Is", after being discovered by Kalawa Jazmee's CEO Oskido.

ras midas.x: Ras Midas is a reggae artist and a member of the Rastafari movement. He gained significant recognition for his album Rastaman in Exile. At the age of 13, he relocated to the United Kingdom.

rascalz.x: Rascalz are a Canadian hip-hop group from Vancouver, British Columbia. The group played a crucial role in the artistic and commercial development of Canadian hip hop as well as specifically for the west coast scene in Vancouver popularizing the term "Van City".

rasco.x: Keida Brewer, known professionally as Rasco, is an American rapper. Born in Cleveland, Ohio, Rasco became associated with hip hop in California. His first album was released on Stones Throw Records.

rea garvey.x: Raymond "Rea" Michael Garvey is an Irish singer, songwriter and guitarist based in Germany. In 1998, he formed the band Reamonn.

redfoo.x: Stefan Kendal Gordy, known professionally as Redfoo, is an American singer, rapper, record producer, disc jockey, and tennis player.

reece madlisa.x: Clive Tshikosi professionally known as Reece Madlisa, is a South African singer and songwriter. He is best known for being a former member of the amapiano duo Amaroto.

reflekt.x: Reflekt were an English electronic music duo consisting of DJ/remixer/producers Seb Fontaine and Julian Peake.

resin dogs.x: Resin Dogs is an Australian hip hop group, formed in Brisbane, Queensland in 1996 based around the founding trio of DJ Katch, producer Blunted Stylus, and drummer, Dave "Acosta" Atkins.

rhye.x: Rhye is an R&B musical project of Canadian singer Mike Milosh. It originally consisted of him and Danish instrumentalist Robin Hannibal. They released the singles "Open" and "The Fall" online without much detail, which led to speculation about the band.

rhys fulber.x: Nowell Rhys Fulber is a Canadian electronic musician and producer. He is a member of Front Line Assembly and Delerium, along with Bill Leeb. He also records under his own name and under the name Conjure One.

richy ahmed.x: Richy Ahmed is a British DJ and producer from South Shields, England.

riky rick.x: Rikhado Makhado, known professionally as Riky Rick, was a South African rapper, singer, songwriter, record producer and entrepreneur.

rmr.x: RMR is an American rapper and singer. He first attained notoriety when his song "Rascal" went viral on YouTube in February 2020. RMR was signed to Warner Records and Cmnty Rcrds from 2020 to 2022.

roisin murphy.x: Róisín Marie Murphy is an Irish singer, songwriter and record producer who first became known in the 1990s as one half of the pop duo Moloko alongside the English musician Mark Brydon.

rokkurro.x: Rökkurró is an Icelandic music group founded in 2006 in Reykjavík. After a 4-track EP, they were signed to 12 Tónar label. Their debut album was Það kólnar í kvöld...

rollo armstrong.x: Rowland Constantine O'Malley Armstrong, known professionally as both Rollo and R Plus, is an English DJ and music producer. He is a member of the remix/production duo Rollo & Sister Bliss and is a founding, non-touring member of the electronic music group Faithless.

rone.x: Rone is a French electronic music producer and artist.

rowlene.x: Rowlene Nicole Bosman, professionally known as Rowlene, is a South African singer and songwriter.

royksopp.x: Röyksopp are a Norwegian electronic music duo from Tromsø formed in 1998. The duo consists of childhood friends Svein Berge and Torbjørn Brundtland, who formed Röyksopp during the Bergen Wave.

rufus du sol.x: Rüfüs Du Sol is an Australian alternative dance group from Sydney that consists of Tyrone Lindqvist, Jon George, and James Hunt.

ryan castro.x: Bryan David Castro Sosa, known professionally as Ryan Castro, is a Colombian rapper, singer, and songwriter. He achieved worldwide recognition for his songs "Quema", "Jordan", "Mujeriego", and "Monastery".

pablo gad.x: Pablo Gad is a British Jamaican Conscious Roots reggae singer and songwriter. He is considered one of the UK's most militant and outspoken vocalists in roots reggae music.

paolo mojo.x: Paolo Mojo, originally from St. Helens, Merseyside, but now based in London, United Kingdom, is an English electronica DJ. His style incorporates the genres of house, funk, techno, breaks, electro, disco, and acid music.

papercut.x: "Papercut" is a song by German DJ and record producer Zedd from his second studio album, True Colors which features vocals from Australian singer-songwriter Troye Sivan.

paradis.x: Paradis is a French electronic music duo consisting of Simon Mény and Pierre Rousseau. The duo was latest signed to Universal label Barclay.

paramida.x: PARAMIDA is a German DJ, music producer, and record label owner with Persian background. Based in Berlin, she is a resident DJ at Berghain's Panoramabar and is a travelling DJ. In 2014, she founded electronic music label, Love on the Rocks.

parov stelar.x: Marcus Füreder, known professionally as Parov Stelar, is an Austrian music producer and DJ. He is considered a pioneer of electro swing and is one of the most internationally successful artists from Austria.

parra for cuva.x: Nicolas Demuth, known by stage name Parra for Cuva, is a German musician and DJ. He is best known for his house production.

patty pravo.x: Nicoletta Strambelli, known professionally as Patty Pravo, is an Italian singer. She debuted in 1966 and remained most successful commercially for the rest of the 1960s and throughout the 1970s.

paul hardcastle.x: Paul Louis Hardcastle is an English composer, musician, record producer, songwriter, radio presenter and multi-instrumentalist. He is best known for his song "19", which went to number one on the UK singles chart in 1985.

paul kalkbrenner.x: Paul Kalkbrenner is a German musician and producer of electronic music. Because he breaks down his tracks into elements that are reassembled onstage, Kalkbrenner is considered a live act, as opposed to a DJ.

paul oakenfold.x: Paul Mark Oakenfold, formerly known mononymously as Oakenfold, is an English record producer, remixer, and electronic music DJ.

paul van dyk.x: Matthias Paul, known professionally as Paul van Dyk is a German DJ, record producer and musician. Van Dyk was the first artist to receive a Grammy Award nomination in the newly added category of Best Dance/Electronic album for his 2003 release Reflections.

paul whiteman.x: Paul Samuel Whiteman was an American jazz bandleader, composer, orchestral director, and violinist.

peggy gou.x: Kim Min-ji, known as Peggy Gou, is a South Korean DJ, singer, songwriter, fashion designer, and record producer based in Berlin, Germany. She has released seven EPs on record labels including Ninja Tune and Phonica.

peter broggs.x: Henry Hugh James, better known as Peter Broggs, was a Jamaican roots reggae vocalist and songwriter.

peter heppner.x: Peter Heppner is the former lead singer of the German electronica/synth pop band Wolfsheim, and has collaborated with many other electronic music acts, such as Paul van Dyk, Schiller, Camouflage, and Goethes Erben.

phace.x: Phace is a German music producer, DJ and label owner living in Hamburg, Germany.

planningtorock.x: Jam Rahuoja Rostron, known by their stage name Planningtorock, is an English electronic musician and record producer who lives in Tallinn, Estonia. Rostron is transgender and non-binary, and uses they/them and he/him pronouns.

playboi carti.x: Jordan Terrell Carter, known professionally as Playboi Carti, is an American rapper. Known for his eccentric vocal style and fashion, he is considered an influential figure in modern hip-hop and a pioneer of the rage microgenre.

practice what you preach.x: Practice What You Preach is the third studio album by American thrash metal band Testament, released on August 8, 1989 via Atlantic/Megaforce.

pride n joy.x: "Pride N Joy" is a song by American rapper Fat Joe. The song features Kanye West, Miguel, Jadakiss, Mos Def, DJ Khaled, Roscoe Dash and Busta Rhymes. The song was produced by Bink! and contains additional songwriting from singer Rico Love.

prince jazzbo.x: Linval Roy Carter, better known as Prince Jazzbo, was a Jamaican reggae and dancehall deejay and producer.

abdominal.x: Andrew Bernstein, better known by his stage name Abdominal, is a Canadian rapper from Toronto, Ontario.

absent minded.x: Absent Minded is the name for Swedish rapper Adam Baptiste, also known as ADL's solo hip hop music when paired with producer Vladi C.

ace of spades.x: "Ace of Spades" is a song by English heavy metal band Motörhead and the title track to the album Ace of Spades. It was released as a single in October 1980. In 2021, Eli Enis of Revolver included the song in his list of the "15 Greatest Album-Opening Songs in Metal".
